plan: Validate candidate snapshots and checksums, then build the complete candidate lineage.
Resolve explicit review supersession, calculate region-scoped staleness, and evaluate policy coverage.
Derive region ancestry and candidate diffs from complete snapshots.
Export canonical JSON into a deterministic stored ZIP with fixed metadata and verified checksums.

trace.source_relation: A stamp attaches to identified plates rather than to an abstract box.
trace.target_mechanism: Reviews use explicit region scopes; transition-by-transition lineage checks stale only scoped regions that changed.

trace.source_relation: A new job can reuse old plates and replace only selected ones.
trace.target_mechanism: Complete candidate snapshots are traversed as a lineage, preserving unchanged-region approvals and producing independent ancestry for each region.

trace.source_relation: Printing starts only when all required current stamps satisfy authorization rules.
trace.target_mechanism: Policy assessment requires usable approval coverage from every required department across every required region and emits sorted blocker explanations.
